summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall='node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods 755, and invokes it to execute math_init.js — a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style file (string-array rotator WV8StW, large numeric constants table n7gIxM, decoder hc1jfK9). The alternate runtime is fetched specifically so a Node-based scanner does not trace the executed code; the payload is opaque and runs automatically on npm install. Package identity is inconsistent with the advertised purpose: the npm name eslint-plugin-folder-schema and the tiny lib/index.js wrapper reference ServiceTitan's folder-lint repository, but the upstream ESLint plugin has no need for a second language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated sibling. This is a fetch-and-execute install-time dropper grafted onto an eslint-plugin-shaped wrapper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
